importDescription: Export a HAR file from your browser’s Network panel, then open it here.
privacy: Processed locally in your browser. Captures are not uploaded or saved to browser storage.
sensitive: HAR files can contain cookies, tokens, and personal data. Take care when copying or sharing their contents.
limits: HAR (.har or .json) · 20 MiB max · 20,000 entries max
summaryNote: Totals cover all readable requests, regardless of filters. Unknown sizes are excluded. Capture span is unavailable if any request duration is missing.
waterfallHint: Requests share one time scale based on recorded starts and known finishes. Select a request to inspect its details.
searchPlaceholder: URL, method, status, or MIME type…
noMatchesHint: Try another search or reset the filters.
valueTruncated: Long values are limited to 100,000 characters in this view.
bodyMissing: No body text was recorded in this HAR.
bodyEncoded: Encoded body shown as stored text, without decoding.
bodyTruncated: Preview limited to 100,000 characters. Copy includes only the displayed text.
sslNote: TLS is included in connection time, so it is not added again. Missing or inapplicable timings are shown as “Not available”.

errors.invalidJson: Could not read JSON. Choose a valid HAR file (.har or .json).
errors.invalidHar: This file is not a HAR capture. Expected an object with a log.entries array.
errors.noValid: No readable requests were found. Check that entries contain valid timestamps, URLs, methods, and responses.
errors.tooLarge: This file exceeds 20 MiB. Export a smaller capture and try again.
errors.tooMany: This capture exceeds 20,000 entries. Export a shorter capture and try again.
errors.readFailed: Could not read the capture. Choose the file again or try another browser.
